To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ANF-R2-mediated signalling is altered in hypertension.
ANF-R2 receptor-mediated inhibition of adenosine cyclase is augmented in hypertension.
ANF-R2 is coupled to adrenergic cyclase/cAMP signalling system in heart and aortic smooth muscle cells and that this coupling is altered in hypertension.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the molecular mechanisms of the pathogenesis of essential hypertension.
the identification of the ANP receptor subtype(s) that is involved in mediating the cardiovascular and renal actions of the hormone.
the elucidation of ANF-R/ANP-C-mediated adenylycylase inhibition as a physiological mechanism of ANP in cardiovascular system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the enhanced ANF-R2 mediated inhibition of adenyyl cyclase in hypertension may be implicated in mediating the physiological responses of ANP.
the enhanced inhibition of ANP on adenylyl cyclic system is associated with hypertension and may be involved in the pathophysiology of hypertension.
ANF-R2 is coupled to adenosine cyclase through Gi-regulatory proteins and the altered ANP-mediated inhibition may be involved in the pathogenesis and progression of hypertension.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

in hypertension, the responsiveness of ANF-R1/ANP-A receptor-mediated signalling is decreased, whereas the ANF-R2-mediated signalling is enhanced, and the ANF-R3/ANP-B receptor-mediated signalling is not altered.
in hypertension, ANP/ANF-R2/ ANP-C receptor-mediated inhibition of adenyl cyclase is enhanced in heart, aorta and brain, but not in adrenal or platelets.
the ANF-R2 / ANP-C receptor mediated adenylyl-cyclase inhibition was enhanced in hypertension, and this alteration may be involved in the pathogenesis and progression of hypertension.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ANF-R2 receptor is coupled to Gi-protein and is involved in mediating some cardiovascular responses to ANP.
the ANP-mediated adenylylcyclase inhibition is augmented in SHR and DOCA-Salt hypertensive rats as compared to WKY and normotensive rats.
the ANP-mediated adenylycylase inhibition is augmented in hypertension.
